title: Device Attestation Flow
description: A Mermaid sequence diagram of TPM-based remote device attestation, showing the nonce challenge, the AIK-signed PCR quote, the verifier's certificate and policy checks, and the resulting attestation token.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Trace the message exchange in TPM-based remote attestation among verifier, device, and hardware root of trust.
Explain why attestation trust depends on both the manufacturer's EK certificate and a current PCR policy.

instructionalStrategies: Read the numbered steps top to bottom and identify what each message proves.
Discuss what the nonce defends against and why the verifier's PCR policy must be kept current.

assessmentQuestions.question: What attack does the nonce N defend against in this exchange?
How could a stale PCR policy allow a compromised device to pass attestation?
